speaker: rich
transcript: Big Mike, I found it. The Gravitas beacon is real. A woman on the ham bands—Cat Eye Eight-One—walked me through the relay. Sixty meters, Channel Two: five point three four six five megahertz, upper sideband. Then Channel One: five point three three zero five, upper sideband. I sent my delivery grid—Foxtrot November One Zero Golf Mike. They repeated my handle, gave me a confirmation code, and accepted a request for one antigen pack. They said a drone would home in on my carrier when it gets close. Write all that down, Mike. This might actually work.
summary: Rich tells Big Mike that the Gravitas beacon is real, gives the two sixty-meter frequencies and delivery grid, and reports that one antigen pack was accepted for drone delivery.
defaultEmotion: energized, hopeful, technically precise, trying not to celebrate too early
